name: S.S. Laurel Clark
about: S.S. Laurel Clark (2023-110A), a crewed vehicle (Cygnus), launched 2023 Aug  2. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2023 Aug  2), held fixed
docked to A06499; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
